# AEONOS

> AEONOS is the agent-callable execution layer for answer engine optimisation (AEO) and generative engine optimisation (GEO). It makes a website citable by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.

Host: aeonos.basechainlabs.com

Pemba is the managed AEO service for small and medium businesses. AEONOS is the agent-callable execution layer: agents call it to run audits, schema, llms.txt, and citation work.

## Install

```
npx aeonos-mcp
```

## Capabilities

- AEO strategy audit: AI readiness score with a P1/P2/P3 roadmap
- JSON-LD schema: production-ready Schema.org markup
- llms.txt: a deploy-ready file for AI crawlers
- Progress report: Four Layers scorecard (SXO, AIO, GEO, AEO)
- Agent query: citation tactics, quick wins, and keyword strategy
- Persistent memory: site context kept across calls when a caller id is supplied

## Pricing

Pay per call in USDC on Base via x402, or with card credits. 1 credit = $0.01 USD. Credits do not expire.

- aeonos_query: 0.05 USDC, or 5 credits
- aeonos_schema: 0.50 USDC, or 50 credits
- aeonos_llms_txt: 0.50 USDC, or 50 credits
- aeonos_progress: 1.50 USDC, or 75 credits
- aeonos_audit: 2.50 USDC, or 100 credits
